afforestation-cost.name: Afforestation Cost Calculator
afforestation-cost.intro: Estimate the investment of an afforestation carbon-sink project from planting area, tree species and unit price, together with its annual carbon uptake.

aqi.name: AQI Health Level Guide
aqi.intro: Turn an air quality index value into a health impact level with outdoor activity advice for polluted days.

aqi-converter.name: AQI Category Converter
aqi-converter.intro: Convert between AQI and PM2.5, PM10 and O3 concentrations following the HJ 633-2012 breakpoint table.

battery-storage.name: Battery Storage Capacity Calculator
battery-storage.intro: Compute usable energy from rated capacity, voltage and depth of discharge for storage and off-grid power planning.

carbon-forest.name: Carbon-Neutral Forest Area Calculator
carbon-forest.intro: Estimate how many trees and how much forest land are needed to offset a given annual carbon emission.

carbon-offset.name: Carbon Footprint & Offset Calculator
carbon-offset.intro: Total your travel, energy, diet and shopping emissions, then see the trees and offsets needed to neutralise them.

convert-air-aqi.name: AQI from PM2.5 Converter
convert-air-aqi.zh: 空气质量指数（AQI）类别换算
convert-air-aqi.intro: Convert a 24-hour PM2.5 concentration into a US EPA AQI value with piecewise-linear breakpoints and the matching category.

eco.name: Carbon Emission Estimator
eco.intro: Estimate CO2 emissions from electricity, gas and other energy use with standard emission factors for a rough carbon footprint.

eco-10.name: Solar PV Emission Reduction Estimator
eco-10.intro: Convert annual solar PV generation into avoided CO2 and the equivalent number of trees planted.

eco-11.name: Traffic Congestion Carbon Emissions
eco-11.intro: Estimate the extra fuel burnt and CO2 emitted by idling and slow traffic from congested distance and vehicle consumption.

eco-14.name: Building Energy Intensity Calculator
eco-14.intro: Compute building energy intensity in kWh per square metre per year for benchmarking and retrofit assessment.

eco-15.name: Wastewater Plant Energy Consumption
eco-15.intro: Compute the specific energy consumption of a wastewater treatment plant in kWh per cubic metre of treated water.

eco-16.name: Wind Power Emission Reduction
eco-16.intro: Convert annual wind power generation into avoided CO2 and the equivalent annual car emissions.

eco-3.name: Wastewater Treatment Load Calculator
eco-3.intro: Estimate the daily COD and pollutant load entering a treatment plant from wastewater flow and pollutant concentration.

eco-4.name: Solid Waste Generation Estimator
eco-4.intro: Estimate total municipal solid waste from population and per-capita generation for sanitation and facility planning.

eco-5.name: Water Saving Rate Calculator
eco-5.intro: Compare water use before and after a saving measure to get the volume saved and the water saving rate.

eco-6.name: Green Coverage Rate Calculator
eco-6.intro: Compute the green coverage ratio from green space and total area, counting tree canopy at half its projection.

eco-7.name: Energy Efficiency Converter
eco-7.intro: Convert energy between units and into coal equivalent or kWh for like-for-like efficiency comparison.

eco-8.name: Carbon Sink Afforestation Estimator
eco-8.intro: Estimate the annual carbon sink of a forest or plantation from area, tree species and stand age.

eco-9.name: Noise Attenuation Distance
eco-9.intro: Estimate how a point sound source level falls off with distance in a free field for noise assessment and plant-boundary prediction.

ecological-footprint.name: Ecological Footprint Estimator
ecological-footprint.intro: Estimate per-capita ecological footprint from consumption data and compare it with the global per-capita biocapacity.

electricity-carbon.name: Electricity Carbon Emission Calculator
electricity-carbon.intro: Estimate CO2 emissions from electricity use with the emission factor (China grid average about 0.581) for carbon accounting.

env-impact-score.name: Environmental Impact Score
env-impact-score.intro: Score energy, water, waste and emission data into a single environmental impact index for comparing options.

fuel-carbon.name: Fuel Carbon Emission Calculator
fuel-carbon.intro: Estimate CO2 from fuel consumption with emission factors (diesel about 2.68 kgCO2 per litre) for transport carbon accounting.

landfill-methane.name: Landfill Methane Generation
landfill-methane.intro: Estimate methane and CO2-equivalent output from landfilled organic waste and the potential emission reduction from recovery.

methane-equivalent.name: Methane CO2-Equivalent Calculator
methane-equivalent.intro: Convert methane emissions into CO2-equivalent using the 100-year global warming potential for greenhouse gas inventories.

noise-addition.name: Noise Level Addition Calculator
noise-addition.intro: Add several sound sources with the logarithmic rule to get the combined level, since decibels cannot simply be summed.

noise-superposition.name: Noise Superposition Calculator
noise-superposition.intro: Combine multiple noise sources by energy addition, adding or removing sources to get the total environmental noise level.

rainwater-harvest.name: Rainwater Harvest Calculator
rainwater-harvest.intro: Estimate collectable rainwater from roof area and rainfall for rainwater harvesting systems and water-saving design.

recycle-rate.name: Waste Recycling Rate Calculator
recycle-rate.intro: Compute the recycling rate and residual landfill volume from total and recycled waste to track sorting performance.

recycling-guide.name: Waste Sorting Guide
recycling-guide.intro: Search a waste item by name to find out which sorting category it belongs to and how it should be disposed of.

solar-output.name: Solar Power Output Calculator
solar-output.intro: Estimate PV output over a period from installed capacity, sunshine hours and system efficiency for yield and benefit estimates.

solid-waste.name: Solid Waste Generation Coefficient
solid-waste.intro: Estimate industrial solid waste generation from product output using the sector emission-coefficient handbook for compliance accounting.

waste-calculator.name: Household Waste Generation Calculator
waste-calculator.intro: Estimate household waste generation from family size, cooking and shopping habits, with practical reduction suggestions.

wastewater-calc.name: Wastewater Discharge Calculator
wastewater-calc.intro: Compute daily wastewater discharge and total pollutant load for environmental compliance and discharge permit accounting.

water-footprint.name: Product Water Footprint
water-footprint.intro: Estimate the virtual water consumption of a product from its type and output for product water footprint and supply-chain assessment.

water-saving.name: Daily Water Saving Calculator
water-saving.intro: Estimate cumulative water saved by efficient fixtures and habits in homes and public buildings.

wind-power.name: Wind Power Output Calculator
wind-power.intro: Compute wind turbine output power from swept area, wind speed and air density, with cut-in and cut-out speed limits.
